summary: Generation Essentials Group filed a Form 6-K announcing a board-approved share repurchase program of up to US$10 million in open-market, privately negotiated, or block-trade transactions, funded from existing cash. Concurrently, controlling shareholder AMTD Digital Inc., directors, and management voluntarily agreed to a two-year lock-up on their TGE shares. The board believes shares trade at a significant discount to net asset value (approximately US$971 million, a 15.8% increase) and total asset value (~US$1.7 billion, up 17.7% after recent hotel acquisitions). Repurchases will comply with Rule 10b-18/10b5-1. The program enhances shareholder value; what to watch is execution pace and whether discount to NAV narrows.
